Prompt

Create a web development agency website:

1. HERO SECTION
- Technical but approachable headline
  - "We Build Web Applications That Scale"
  - "Custom Software Solutions for Growing Businesses"
- Brief description of capabilities
- CTAs: "Start a Project" / "View Our Work"

Visual:
- Code animation
- Tech-themed graphics
- Interactive element

2. TECH STACK
"Technologies We Work With"

Frontend:
- React, Vue, Angular
- Next.js, Nuxt
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS

Backend:
- Node.js, Python, Go
- PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- AWS, GCP, Azure

Mobile:
- React Native
- Flutter
- iOS/Android native

Format: Logo grid with hover states

3. SERVICES
- Web Application Development
- E-commerce Development
- API Development & Integration
- Mobile App Development
- Cloud Architecture
- DevOps & CI/CD
- Maintenance & Support

4. FEATURED PROJECTS
For each project:
- Project name and client
- Problem solved
- Tech stack used (icons)
- Key features
- Results/metrics
- Screenshots or video
- "View Case Study"

5. DEVELOPMENT PROCESS
Phases:
1. Discovery & Planning
   - Requirements gathering
   - Technical architecture
2. Design & Prototyping
   - UI/UX design
   - Interactive prototypes
3. Development
   - Agile sprints
   - Regular demos
4. Testing & QA
   - Automated testing
   - Performance optimization
5. Launch & Support
   - Deployment
   - Monitoring
   - Ongoing maintenance

6. TEAM
- Senior developers
- Tech leads
- Project managers
- Show expertise and experience
- GitHub/LinkedIn links

7. ENGAGEMENT MODELS
- Dedicated Team
- Project-Based
- Time & Materials
- Staff Augmentation

Explain each model

8. TESTIMONIALS
- Technical testimonials
- "They delivered on time and budget"
- CTO/Tech lead quotes

9. BLOG/TECHNICAL CONTENT
- Engineering blog posts
- Open source contributions
- Technical case studies

10. CONTACT
- "Let's discuss your project"
- Project inquiry form
  - Project type
  - Timeline
  - Budget range
  - Technical requirements
- NDA option for sensitive projects

Design: Clean, professional. Technical credibility. Show code/tech where appropriate.
